messages:
sophia: Heads-up — found a broken fragment link in the KB that looks like an orphan anchor. Example: https://kb.redwood.ai/serving/runtime#kv-cache-deepdive resolves to the page but the fragment doesn’t jump. I think the header id changed to `kv-cache-deep-dive`. Anyone own /serving/runtime?

kai: thanks — can you paste the exact failing URL (staging or prod)? :eyes:

sophia: posted prod above. Staging link is the same path. Quick local check: `git grep -n "kv-cache-deepdive"` returns a reference in one tutorial, so it’s live in some pages. Header in runtime.md is `## KV cache deep dive` which yields `#kv-cache-deep-dive`.

aj: got it. Could be a manual edit that changed the heading text but not the old anchor. If that’s the case we should update callers. @ryan did you touch runtime last week?

ryan: yeah I did a small restructure last Tue to split the runtime guide. I renamed a few headings for clarity. I didn’t intentionally remove anchors but that explains it. Happy to own the fix.

sophia: cool — I can open a tiny PR to update the link(s) to `#kv-cache-deep-dive`. Proposed quick command for finding occurrences:

```
# find files and replace in a branch (do in a branch, not directly)
git grep -l "kv-cache-deepdive" | xargs sed -i 's/kv-cache-deepdive/kv-cache-deep-dive/g'
```

kai: please don’t run a mass sed on main. Instead create a branch, run replacements there, and open PR so CI/preview can validate. Also maybe add a small docs-lint check for broken fragments so we catch regressions.

ryan: agreed. I’ll add a tiny rule to the docs checker to surface fragment mismatches (short-term). For now @sophia can open the PR and add `owners: @ryan` to the runtime frontmatter so the team knows who to ping.

docs-bot: Link checker (staging) detected 1 failing fragment: `/serving/runtime.html#kv-cache-deepdive` — created issue #4321.

aj: :thumbsup: thanks. Plan: sophia opens PR, ryan reviews and adds the lint follow-up. Kai will review if any broader changes are needed.

sophia: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 — tiny patch updating 3 links and adding `owners: "@ryan"` to the frontmatter. CI preview running. cc @ryan

ryan: looking now. tiny nit: could you include a short changelog line in the PR body so the release notes team can track doc fixes?

sophia: added a one-line changelog. Merge when CI is green.

kai: once merged, can someone run the link-check job again and paste any diffs here? If the fragment-checker change looks good we can roll it into the next docs CI update.

ryan: will follow up post-merge and file a follow-up issue for the lint.

sophia: thanks all — resolving for now. If anyone sees other stray anchors ping here.
